audits.title: 661 Improving Antibiotic Prescribing in a District General Hospital: A Closed Loop Audit
audits.standard: Local hospital antibiotic guidelines for appendicectomy
audits.setting: Borders General Hospital, district general hospital

cycle1.result: 68.8% (11/16) compliance with local antibiotic guidelines; non-compliant cases had correct antibiotics but different gentamicin doses.

audits.intervention: Antibiotic prescribing teaching for surgical and anaesthetic doctors, including use of the gentamicin dosing calculator.
audits.other_findings: Gaps in prescriber awareness of antibiotic guidelines were identified at baseline.
audits.citation: Ng Z, Kamran T. 661 Improving Antibiotic Prescribing in a District General Hospital: A Closed Loop Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2021;108(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znab259.083.

audits.title: 493 Audit of Antibiotic Prescriptions in Appendicectomies and Adherence of Surgeons to National and Local Trust Guidelines: Preoperative and Postoperative
audits.standard: BMJ Best Practice (preoperative prophylaxis for all; postoperative antibiotics only for complicated cases) and local trust MicroGuide guidelines
audits.setting: District general hospital, Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 100% received prophylaxis but only 25% of penicillin-allergic and 2.2% of non-allergic patients received trust-adherent agents; 100% of complicated cases had postoperative antibiotics while 80% of uncomplicated cases had them unnecessarily.

audits.other_findings: Complicated cases made up 30%; presentation at audit meeting, MicroGuide awareness and re-audit are planned.
audits.citation: Al-Balah A, Iskandar A, Yousof H. 493 Audit of Antibiotic Prescriptions in Appendicectomies and Adherence of Surgeons to National and Local Trust Guidelines: Preoperative and Postoperative. British Journal of Surgery. 2023;110(Supplement_7). doi:10.1093/bjs/znad258.111.

audits.title: 552 Appendix Out, Antibiotics Out: A Closed-Loop Audit of Post-Operative Use of Antibiotics After Appendicectomy
audits.standard: World Journal of Emergency Surgery and BMJ guidance: no postoperative antibiotics for uncomplicated appendicitis and no more than 3 to 5 days for complicated appendicitis
audits.setting: District general hospital, Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust, London

cycle1.result: 90.2% of uncomplicated cases received postoperative antibiotics; mean course 7.8 days in complicated and 2.9 days in uncomplicated appendicitis.

audits.intervention: Findings presented at the local surgical forum and clinical governance meeting, and a poster displayed in emergency theatres

cycle2.result: 84.4% of uncomplicated cases received postoperative antibiotics; mean course 6.3 days in complicated and 2.7 days in uncomplicated appendicitis.

audits.other_findings: Adherence remained poor after the intervention, especially routine antibiotics in uncomplicated cases.
audits.citation: Wylleman E, Bapir L, Pawa N. 552 Appendix Out, Antibiotics Out: A Closed-Loop Audit of Post-Operative Use of Antibiotics After Appendicectomy. British Journal of Surgery. 2026;113(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znag063.228.

audits.title: 601 Compliance With Perioperative Antibiotic Guidelines in Patients Undergoing Emergency Appendicectomy: A Three-Cycle Audit
audits.standard: WSES acute appendicitis 2020 and local guidelines

cycle1.result: Preoperative antibiotics 85%; omission of postoperative antibiotics in simple appendicitis 79%; 3-5 days postoperative antibiotics in complicated appendicitis 12.1%.

audits.intervention: Local presentation, informative posters in clinical areas, local guidelines and an appendicectomy operation note proforma.

cycle2.result: Preoperative antibiotics 95%; omission in simple appendicitis 97%; 3-5 days in complicated appendicitis 61%.

audits.other_findings: Three cycles; the 2023 cycle showed 87%, 100% and 20% respectively. Postoperative antibiotics in complicated appendicitis remain inconsistent.
audits.citation: Windith A, Khaw R, Waddell K, Robinson S. 601 Compliance With Perioperative Antibiotic Guidelines in Patients Undergoing Emergency Appendicectomy: A Three-Cycle Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2026;113(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znag063.232.

audits.title: TPW 5.04 Introduction of Post-Operative Antibiotic Guidelines Leads to Reduced Length of Post-Operative Stay and Improved Antimicrobial Stewardship in Uncomplicated Appendicectomy: A Single Centre Closed-Loop Audit
audits.standard: World Journal of Emergency Surgery Jerusalem guidelines: no postoperative antibiotics for uncomplicated appendicitis
audits.setting: Single UK centre (Royal Surrey County Hospital NHS Foundation Trust)

cycle1.result: 54.3% of uncomplicated appendicitis cases (n=46) did not receive postoperative antibiotics; mean postoperative stay 23.3 hours.

cycle2.result: 78.3% of uncomplicated cases (n=46) did not receive postoperative antibiotics (p = 0.0024); mean postoperative stay 14.5 hours (p = 0.0002).

audits.other_findings: No significant difference in complications and no C. difficile cases in either cycle.
audits.citation: Forder B, Crowe O, Singh R. TPW 5.04 Introduction of Post-Operative Antibiotic Guidelines Leads to Reduced Length of Post-Operative Stay and Improved Antimicrobial Stewardship in Uncomplicated Appendicectomy: A Single Centre Closed-Loop Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2026;113(Supplement_8). doi:10.1093/bjs/znag087.346.

audits.title: TPTh 4.03 Improving Antimicrobial Stewardship in Acute Appendicitis Through Education and System-Level Documentation Redesign: A Closed-Loop Audit at Wirral University Teaching Hospital NHS Trust
audits.standard: WSES 2020 guidelines: post-operative antibiotic use and duration, intra-operative documentation of severity and contamination, microbiological sampling
audits.setting: Wirral University Teaching Hospital NHS Trust

cycle1.result: Mean antibiotic duration in complicated appendicitis 9.2 days.

audits.intervention: Consultant-led education and a revised electronic laparoscopic appendicectomy theatre note with guideline prompts.

cycle2.result: Antibiotic duration in complicated appendicitis fell to 8.4 days.

audits.other_findings: Variation persisted in prescribing for uncomplicated appendicitis; negative appendicectomy rate 6.5%.
audits.citation: Ladi A, Mustafai M, Buckley K. TPTh 4.03 Improving Antimicrobial Stewardship in Acute Appendicitis Through Education and System-Level Documentation Redesign: A Closed-Loop Audit at Wirral University Teaching Hospital NHS Trust. British Journal of Surgery. 2026;113(Supplement_8). doi:10.1093/bjs/znag087.455.

audits.title: TPTh 4.09 Post-Operative Antibiotic use Following Appendectomy: A Retrospective Audit of Guideline Adherence
audits.standard: BMJ Best Practice guidance on post-operative antibiotics after appendicectomy (total duration 5 days)
audits.setting: Chesterfield Royal Hospital NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 52/67 (77.6%) uncomplicated cases received post-operative antibiotics; where op note said no further antibiotics this was followed in 14/29 (48%); compliance with specified duration or route 27.78%; 47 complicated cases received ~3 days IV then 5 days oral.

audits.intervention: Recommendations implemented and targeted teaching sessions for junior doctors; second cycle planned.
audits.other_findings: 25 uncomplicated patients were discharged with more than 5 days of oral antibiotics.
audits.citation: Hanna Y, Rothwell T, Hamed Y, Ball-wood A, Aly M, Hope C. TPTh 4.09 Post-Operative Antibiotic use Following Appendectomy: A Retrospective Audit of Guideline Adherence. British Journal of Surgery. 2026;113(Supplement_8). doi:10.1093/bjs/znag087.461.
